note: By-election of an alderman for Pottinger Ward, 2 July 1930, to fill a casual vacancy. Returned unopposed. Register remarks: vice Alderman McMordie resigned 28 Apr 1930; his councillor seat (vacant 1 Aug 1930) not filled.
